_about: Soft Luxe Serif v9 (trained 5 Oct 2026 from 11 Top-100 refs: vanogre.edits r38/r39, dina_visuals, tians028 x2, bigeditor.60fps, bluumediahouse, gongkianist, rabinn.fx x2, vince200103; ~/reels/style-train/soft-luxe-serif). Speaker in natural soft colour (no heavy grade), tiny low-key sans captions of 1-3 words, and ONE keyword per line set big in a glowing serif italic in a warm accent (gold by default; blue / red variants). Warm COLOUR b-roll (aerials, architecture, interiors) with captions kept on, sparse quiet sound, calm bed.

director.style: Soft Luxe Serif: a quiet, premium talking-head edit. The speaker stays natural, a touch moody (plate pulled down to ~luma 89, brightness 0.78); typography whispers (tiny sans words) and then lands ONE elegant word per line in a big glowing serif italic. Warm colour b-roll gives the luxury feel. Restraint is the brand.
director.captions: captions.highlight: 4-7 keywords per 20 s (nouns or numbers that carry the line: 'potential', 'patterns', '2032', 'knowledge'); never filler ('really', 'cause', 'things'). They render as the big serif italic accent. Everything else stays tiny lowercase sans, 2 words per line.
director.cutaways: About 2 image scenes per 20 s (v3: 4 measured too busy), captions: true, 1.0-2.0 s, warm COLOUR stills (not B&W): aerial city at golden hour, architecture, marble/wood interiors, campus or property exteriors. Public domain / CC0 only via stock_fetch.py. Slow push (zoom 1.02 -> 1.12).
director.rhythm: Calm: a picture change every ~3 s (measure v2 counts punch-ins too, so cadence.minGap 3.5 keeps them sparse) plus cutaways. No flashes, no glitch, hard cuts or a soft blur into b-roll. One light whoosh at most per cutaway; no hit on every keyword.
